description: Build complete regime UI: backend endpoints for current regime and history, frontend components (RegimeStatus badge with live polling, RegimePerformance stats table, RegimeTimeline 24h chart), and integration into StatusBar and new /regime page with navbar link.
steps: Add GET /api/regime/current?underlying=NIFTY endpoint to c:\Users\rushi\Downloads\try12fin\try12\backend\app\api\routes\regime.py. Read regime:{underlying}:current from Redis via redis_cache.get(f'regime:{underlying}:current'), parse JSON, return {regime: str, since: ISO timestamp, seconds_in_regime: int}. Handle missing key by returning {regime: 'UNKNOWN', since: null, seconds_in_regime: 0}. Use redis_cache._r() directly since redis_cache.get() auto-parses JSON.

Add GET /api/regime/history?underlying=NIFTY&hours=24 endpoint to c:\Users\rushi\Downloads\try12fin\try12\backend\app\api\routes\regime.py. Query regime_states table (RegimeStateModel) for rows where underlying matches and timestamp >= now - hours. Order by timestamp DESC. Return list of {regime: str, timestamp: ISO, adx: float, atr: float, previous_regime: str | null}. Use Depends(get_db) for DB session, follow pattern from get_regime_performance endpoint.
Register new endpoints in main.py by verifying regime_router is already included (line 'app.include_router(regime_router, prefix="/api/regime")' exists).

Create frontend type definitions: add RegimeStatus interface {regime: string; since: string | null; seconds_in_regime: number} and RegimeHistoryEntry interface {regime: string; timestamp: string; adx: number | null; atr: number | null; previous_regime: string | null} to c:\Users\rushi\Downloads\try12fin\try12\frontend\types\market.ts (create file if missing, or add to existing types file).

Add API functions to c:\Users\rushi\Downloads\try12fin\try12\frontend\lib\api.ts: export const getCurrentRegime = (underlying = 'NIFTY') => api.get<RegimeStatus>(`/regime/current`, { params: { underlying } }).then(r => r.data); and export const getRegimeHistory = (underlying = 'NIFTY', hours = 24) => api.get<RegimeHistoryEntry[]>(`/regime/history`, { params: { underlying, hours } }).then(r => r.data);

Create c:\Users\rushi\Downloads\try12fin\try12\frontend\components\regime\RegimeStatus.tsx: 'use client' component that polls getCurrentRegime('NIFTY') every 5s with useQuery. Display regime name as a color-coded badge (green for TRENDING_UP/TRENDING_DOWN, yellow for SIDEWAYS_CHOP/VWAP_MAGNET, red for EXPIRY_DAY/REGIME_TRANSITION, gray for UNKNOWN). Show seconds_in_regime as a live counter (format as MM:SS or HH:MM:SS). Use inline styles matching StatusBar pattern with CSS vars. Follow existing StatusBar component structure for styling and layout.

Create c:\Users\rushi\Downloads\try12fin\try12\frontend\components\regime\RegimePerformance.tsx: 'use client' component that fetches from existing /api/regime/performance every 30s with useQuery. Display as a table with columns: Regime, Strategy, Total Trades, Win Rate, Total P&L, Avg P&L. Use inline styles with CSS vars, follow existing table patterns. Color-code P&L values (green positive, red negative). Format numbers with formatNumber/formatPrice from @/lib/utils.

Create c:\Users\rushi\Downloads\try12fin\try12\frontend\components\regime\RegimeTimeline.tsx: 'use client' component that fetches getRegimeHistory('NIFTY', 24) every 60s with useQuery. Display as a horizontal timeline chart showing regime changes over 24 hours. Use simple div-based visualization with color blocks for each regime period. Show regime name and duration on hover. Use inline styles with CSS vars. Keep it simple — no chart library needed, just colored horizontal bars with timestamps.

Integrate RegimeStatus into c:\Users\rushi\Downloads\try12fin\try12\frontend\components\market\StatusBar.tsx: add import and render <RegimeStatus /> as a new section after the Broker section, before the Clock spacer. Add a border-right divider following the existing pattern (px-3 with borderRight: '1px solid var(--border)').

Create new page c:\Users\rushi\Downloads\try12fin\try12\frontend\app\regime\page.tsx: 'use client' page that renders a dashboard with <RegimePerformance /> and <RegimeTimeline /> stacked vertically. Add page title 'Regime Analysis Dashboard'. Use flex column layout with gap-4, padding p-6, background var(--surface). Follow existing page structure patterns from other app/ routes.

Add Regime nav link to c:\Users\rushi\Downloads\try12fin\try12\frontend\components\market\NavBar.tsx: add { href: '/regime', label: 'Regime' } to the LINKS array after 'Market Study' entry. The existing map/render logic will handle the new link automatically.
Verify all new files are created and all integrations are complete. Check that StatusBar shows regime badge, navbar has Regime link, /regime page loads with both components.
Commit all changes with message 'feat: add regime UI with current status, performance stats, and timeline'.
